messages.subject: Brampton (Atlas) - earn-out true-up question
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Unrelated to Polaris - on the Atlas/Brampton deal, the sellers' representative has queried the FY25 earn-out true-up calculation. Could one of the team take a quick look at the completion accounts mechanism in that SPA and let me know whether their reading is right? No urgency, but would be good to close it off before the quarter end.

Thanks,
Nathan
